subject.title: feat: a best-in-class Usage & Spend dashboard — model/tool views, accurate spend, token activity heatmap

question: Should CodexBar reattribute usage from a client tool to a third-party billing vendor solely from model identifiers, including for partial model breakdowns, or should the dashboard keep tool/provider-origin grouping until a narrower contract is approved?
rationale: This choice determines what users believe they paid for and cannot be resolved mechanically from scanner data; the linked feature discussion explicitly leaves attribution, double-counting, and currency semantics open.

options.title: Approve a narrow attribution contract
options.body: Define approved model-to-vendor rules and require reconciliation of partial breakdowns and source-specific cost provenance before merging the subscription view.

options.title: Keep origin-based grouping
options.body: Retain model and tool views but defer vendor reattribution so each total remains associated with the source that reported it.

options.title: Split attribution into follow-up work
options.body: Land only independently correct dashboard and scanner work after fixes, then design billing attribution separately.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow attribution contract
recommendation.body: Define approved model-to-vendor rules and require reconciliation of partial breakdowns and source-specific cost provenance before merging the subscription view.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked design discussion requests repository-level decisions on model identity, cross-provider aggregation, and billing semantics.
